historical_record.description: The Hayes Valley Housing North site held 134 dwelling units, which a conditional use application proposed to demolish for a planned unit development of 85 affordable homes.

The City Planning Commission approved with conditions, 6-0, demolishing the 134 public housing units of Hayes Valley Housing North for a planned unit development of 85 affordable homes (Motion 13841).
